desc:
📃Regarding: The horror game adapted from the Chinese animated series "Bear Hunting". It underwent a comprehensive upgrade in June 2026. 

The game currently has one chapter, and more chapters may be added in the future.

📃 Introduction: In 2035, humans conducted experiments on living animals in search of eternal life, but accidentally contracted the zombie virus, plunging Dog Bear Ridge into crisis. You are the saviors of this forest. 

❗Warning: This game contains springboards, loud noises, flashing lights, and more. Play at your own risk! 

🌺 Join the group to receive update notifications: 
https://www.roblox.com/communities/34196492/S-GAMES-UGC#!/about

🔻Closing the door = Update! 

🖥️ Control 
- LShift for sprinting 
- U to unlock the mouse 
- F to turn on personal flashlight light 

🔗 Tags: China, Cartoon, Horror, Survival 

If you find any bugs or issues, please report them to our communication server!
For the best experience, use headphones.
